column1: # THE GATING CHECKS REGISTRY (scripts/ci/gating_checks.py): every check THE GATE reads -- a gate workflow, each job a run
# of one shows, each runner label its jobs ask for -- with the green run on main that PROVED it (its #number). A check
# lands as `unproven` (its note: owner and why) and REPORTS until its first green run: a gate run red only in unproven
# jobs, and the aggregates that follow them, holds no push. `scripts/ci/gating_checks.py prove --workflow-file F
# --run <run id> --number <#n>` records a green run; `lint` keeps every row and every job in step.
# `aggregate`: a job that fails only because one it waits on did (a reusable call's wrapper, timings, a verdict).
